title: 2006 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Fire Dog
seo_title: 2006 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Fire Dog (29 January – 17 February 2007)
description: 2006 is the Year of the Fire Dog (Yang, Bing-xu), from 29 January 2006 to 17 February 2007. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 2006.
lead: Born in 2006? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Dog, but check the date: the 2006 Fire Dog year began on 29 January 2006. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 2006: Year of the Fire Dog, from 29 January 2006 to 17 February 2007.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 2006 was the Year of the Dog. It began with Lunar New Year on 29 January 2006 and ended on 17 February 2007, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 2006 ends in 6, which makes it a Fire year, and as an even year it is Yang. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 2006 is a Bing-xu year. The same Fire Dog combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1946 before it and 2066 after it.
Lunar New Year 2006 fell on 29 January 2006. Anyone born from 1 January 2006 up to the day before belongs to the previous year's animal, the Rooster; from 29 January 2006 on, the Dog.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Dog guide describes the sign like this: “Loyal, honest, and protective. Dogs are deeply trustworthy and stand up for what they believe in.” The usual watch-out: “Can be anxious or overly suspicious of new situations.”

The Fire element adds its own flavour. Fire years bring passion, energy, and boldness. People of this element tend to be dynamic, adventurous, and quick to lead. Read more in our Fire element guide, or the full Year of the Dog page.
Careers often linked with the Dog: law, security, social work, education.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 2006
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Dog's best matches are the Tiger, Horse and Rabbit, and its clash sign is the Dragon, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Dog, it shares the Horse's triangle, so 2026 is traditionally one of its friendlier years.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Dog, it has no special traditional relationship with the Goat, so 2027 is a neutral year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Dog years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1982 (Water Dog); 1994 (Wood Dog); 2018 (Earth Dog); 2030 (Metal Dog). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 2006 is the Year of the Dog, a Yang Fire Dog year (Bing-xu).
When does the 2006 Year of the Dog start and end?
It starts on 29 January 2006 and ends on 17 February 2007.
I was born in January 2006. What is my Chinese zodiac?
If you were born before 29 January 2006, you are a Rooster; from 29 January 2006 on, a Dog.
Fire. 2006 ends in 6, which belongs to Fire, and it is a Yang year.
Who is the Dog compatible with?
Traditionally the Tiger, Horse and Rabbit. The Dog's clash sign is the Dragon.
